Landing.heroTitle: For those who've always been called <glow>too much.</glow>
Landing.heroLead: Here, Bads step up to the height chart and Visitors come to see them. No photos to scroll through endlessly: a visit request, a bet on a Record, and a real conversation in the Visiting Room.
Landing.logoAlt: Bad Boys & Bad Girls, Guilty of charm…
Landing.consentTitle: Here, nothing happens without your consent.
Landing.consentBody: Bad or Visitor, everyone stays in control. The Bad chooses who to receive, the Visitor chooses who to visit and when.
Landing.charterLead: “Bad” is an attitude and a style. Never an excuse.
Landing.finalBody: Your Case File or your Permit is waiting.
Landing.doorHint_bad: I step up to the height chart and receive visits
Landing.doorHint_visitor: I'm looking for a bad boy or a bad girl

steps_bad.title: Open your Case File
steps_bad.body: Your photo against the height chart, your distinctive marks and your Record: three charges, one true and two false.

steps_bad.title: The Mailbox
steps_bad.body: Visit requests land in your Mailbox. You read the Visitor's Permit and decide: visit accepted or case dismissed.

steps_bad.title: The Visiting Room
steps_bad.body: You set your Visiting Hours. In the Visiting Room, you talk for thirty minutes live. If you both want to carry on, the Permit becomes permanent.

steps_visitor.title: Get your Permit
steps_visitor.body: A photo, your Reason for visiting and ten questions. The Registry approves your photo and issues your Permit.

steps_visitor.title: Ask for a visit
steps_visitor.body: Drawn to a Bad? Read their Record and bet on the charge you think is true. Right or wrong, your request goes out: your bet stays secret until the visit.

steps_visitor.title: The Visiting Room
steps_visitor.body: Pick one of the Visiting Hours offered. The conversation opens with your bet, revealed to both of you: nobody has to write the first message.

Landing.promenadeBody: Every night at 9 pm, five Bads step out into the yard for each Visitor, picked from your answers to the questionnaire. A selection, not an endless catalogue.
Landing.quartersBody: An empty dating site is useless. We open block by block, starting with the Var and the Alpes-Maritimes. Bads sign up first; Visitors get their Permit and follow their block's gauge. Visits open once there are enough Bads.

Charter.title: “Bad, not toxic” Charter
Charter.lead: “Bad” is an attitude and a style: honesty, boldness, a taste for freedom. It is never an excuse to hurt anyone. By signing up, you commit to these rules.

sections.title: What we value
items: Honesty: say what you think, respectfully.
Boldness: dare to ask for a visit, dare to suggest a Getaway.
Humour: a funny Record beats ten compliments.
Freedom: everyone decides who they meet and at what pace.

sections.title: What we sanction
items: Harassment: insisting after a case is dismissed, creating several accounts, chasing someone who doesn't reply.
Contempt: insults, humiliation, remarks about body, gender, origin or orientation.
Control: demanding proof, photos, reports or exclusivity before you've even met.
Unsolicited sexual content, threats, violence.
Scams: requests for money, codes, gift cards, dodgy links.

sections.title: What is simply forbidden
items: Being a minor, or talking about minors in a sexual way.
Pretending to be someone else.
Describing real crimes, violence or drugs in your Record: the Record is a game.
Posting your contact details, or someone else's, in your File.

sections.title: Here, nothing happens without your consent
items: The Bad chooses who to receive, the Visitor chooses who to visit and when. “Case dismissed” is a complete answer: it's not up for debate. After a visit, nothing continues unless you both agree.
You can block or report anyone, at any time. Blocking is immediate and works both ways.
Every report is read by a human. You receive the reasons for the decision.

sections.title: What's at stake
items: A warning, a temporary suspension or a permanent ban, depending on severity.
Every decision is reasoned. Both the sanctioned person and the reporter receive the reasons.

Safety.title: Safety tips
Safety.lead: Meeting up is the goal. Doing it safely is the rule.

sections.title: Before the Getaway
items: Stay in the Visiting Room until you feel confident: you can block and report at any time there.
Never share money, verification codes, gift cards or bank details. Nobody sincere will ask you for them.
Be wary of stories that are too perfect, sudden emergencies and people who want to leave the site quickly.

sections.title: On the day
items: First date in a busy public place: bar, café, gig, lively walk.
Tell someone close: where you're going, with whom, and when you plan to be back.
Get there and back on your own. Keep your phone charged.
Keep an eye on your drink.

sections.title: If something feels wrong
items: You can leave at any time, without explaining yourself.
Report the person from their File or from the Visiting Room. Every report is read by a human.
In immediate danger, call 17 (police, France) or 112 (European emergency number). For gender-based and sexual violence in France: 3919, free and anonymous.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: These terms govern the use of Bad Boys & Bad Girls, a dating site for adults, published on a non-professional basis by a private individual (see the legal notice).

sections.title: 2. Access
paragraphs: The service is reserved for people aged 18 or over. Your date of birth is checked at sign-up and an age attestation is required.
The service is free. No paid option lets you send more visit requests or be more visible.

sections.title: 3. Your account and File
paragraphs: You agree to provide accurate information, use photos of yourself, and create only one account.
Your main photo must show your face. Photos are checked by a human before becoming visible.
Your photo is cut out automatically and placed on the background of the site.

sections.title: 4. Forbidden content
paragraphs: Forbidden: references to real crimes, violence, drugs or minors; explicit sexual content; personal contact details in your File, Visiting Permit, Record or visit requests; scams; harassment; impersonation.
Conduct rules are detailed in the “Bad, not toxic” Charter, which is part of these terms.

sections.title: 5. Moderation and sanctions
paragraphs: Every member can report a File, a Visiting Permit, a photo, a Record, a visit request or a message. Reports are handled by a human.
Depending on severity: warning, suspension or ban. Every decision is reasoned and sent to the person concerned and to the reporter.

You can appeal a moderation decision by writing to bad-boys-web@proton.me within 6 months, explaining why. The decision is reviewed and you get a reasoned answer within 30 days. You may still bring the matter before the competent courts.

sections.title: 6. Deleting your account
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time from your settings. Deletion is final: your File or Visiting Permit, your photos and the text of your messages are erased.

sections.title: 7. Liability
paragraphs: The site connects adults. The publisher does not verify members' real identity and does not guarantee their sincerity or behaviour. Each member is solely responsible for what they say and do, online and during a real-life meeting. Follow the Safety tips, choose a public place for a first meeting and report any suspicious behaviour. The publisher promptly removes any illegal content reported to it.

sections.title: 8. Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, an amicable solution is sought first by writing to bad-boys-web@proton.me. Failing that, the French courts have jurisdiction; as a consumer, you may also bring the case before the court where you live.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is the publisher of the site, a private individual acting on a non-professional basis (see the legal notice), reachable at bad-boys-web@proton.me.
No data protection officer has been appointed. For any question about your data: bad-boys-web@proton.me.

sections.title: 2. What we collect, and why
paragraphs: We only collect what serves a visible feature: your email (login and notifications), your date of birth (age check; only your age is shown), your nickname, gender, role (Bad or Visitor), city (never an address or GPS location), photos, Record or Reason for visiting, questionnaire answers, visit requests, visits and messages.

The genders you are looking for may reveal your sexual orientation: this is sensitive data. It is only used to show you compatible profiles, with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time (as the service can then no longer work, account deletion will be offered).

sections.title: 3. Photos
paragraphs: Photo metadata (including GPS location) is removed before upload and checked on our servers.

Once approved, your photos are served from a long, unguessable web address. That address is renewed when you delete a photo, after 30 days on pause and in case of a ban; everything is erased when you delete your account.
Your photo is cut out automatically and placed on the background of the site.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and notifications
paragraphs: We only use strictly necessary cookies (login session, language). No advertising trackers, no external analytics: that's why no consent banner is shown.

Notifications: if you accept them, we send you notifications (visit reminders, new requests) through your browser's notification service (Google for Chrome and Android, Mozilla for Firefox, Apple for Safari). Their content is encrypted and deliberately neutral: never a nickname, a photo or a message. These services only see that a notification is being sent to you. You can turn them off at any time in your settings or your browser's.

To send you these notifications, we keep, for each browser where you turn them on, the subscription address given by that service, two encryption keys and the language of the notifications. This data is erased as soon as you turn notifications off on that browser, or when the service tells us the subscription has expired. You can subscribe 5 browsers at most.

sections.title: 5. Retention
paragraphs: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. An account whose sign-up isn't completed is deleted after 30 days.
After a ban, only an encrypted fingerprint of the email is kept for 12 months to prevent re-registration.

sections.title: 6. Hosting and processors
paragraphs: Database and files: Supabase, European Union region. Application: Vercel. Emails: Brevo. Anti-bot protection: Cloudflare Turnstile.

The database and files are hosted in the European Union. The application is served by Vercel Inc. (United States): any transfers are covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses included in our providers' data processing agreements.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You can export your data (JSON) and delete your account from your settings. You also have the rights of access, rectification, objection and restriction, and may lodge a complaint with the CNIL.
Write to bad-boys-web@proton.me. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

sections.title: Publisher
paragraphs: This site is published on a non-professional basis by a private individual. In accordance with article 6, III, 2 of French law no. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004 on confidence in the digital economy, their identity has been provided to the host, Vercel Inc., which keeps it available to the authorities.
Publication director: the publisher of the site (private individual, see above).
